name: NVIDIA B300 (HGX, SXM)

sources.title: NVIDIA HGX platform page (HGX B300 specs)
Supermicro SYS-822GS-NB3RT (HGX B300, 8U air) product page
NVIDIA Developer Blog: Inside NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra

summary: Blackwell Ultra SXM GPU as used on the 8-GPU HGX B300 baseboard. Runs at up to 1,100 W in OEM HGX systems, air or liquid cooled. Compute figures are dense.

tdpW.note: Supermicro: eight 1100W HGX B300 GPUs in the 8U air-cooled system; the GB300 superchip variant runs higher (up to 1,400 W).

fp8Pflops.note: Dense. NVIDIA lists 72 PFLOPS FP8 sparse per HGX B300 (8 GPUs); dense is half: 72 / 2 / 8 = 4.5.

fp4Pflops.note: Dense. NVIDIA lists 108 PFLOPS FP4 dense per HGX B300 (8 GPUs): 108 / 8 = 13.5.

hbmGb.note: Supermicro: 288 GB HBM3e per GPU. NVIDIA's HGX page lists 2.1 TB per 8 GPUs (about 262 GB usable per GPU).
